title: FedMust: Semi-supervised Multi-task Student-Teacher Federated Learning for Multi-organ CT Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2609.24627v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-organ segmentation using deep learning requires large amounts of annotated patient data; however, institutions often lack sufficiently large and diverse annotated datasets. Privacy constraints further prevent institutions from sharing patient data to overcome this limitation. Moreover, due to the labor-intensive nature of annotation and the scarcity of diverse expertise, institutions typically have labels for only a small portion of their local data, leaving the larger unlabeled portion unused. In this work, we propose a flexible semi-supervised federated multi-task student-teacher framework that leverages federated learning (FL) to improve multi-organ segmentation using both labeled and unlabeled data across participating sites. At each communication round, the proposed framework initiates local training, where clients with labels for the same task form a federation to produce an aggregated teacher model. translated_title: FedMust：面向多器官CT分割的半监督多任务师生联邦学习框架
translated_abstract: 使用深度学习进行多器官分割需要大量有标注的患者数据；然而，各机构往往缺乏足够大规模且多样化的标注数据集。隐私限制进一步阻碍了机构之间共享患者数据以克服这一限制。此外，由于标注工作的劳动密集性质以及多样化专业知识的稀缺，各机构通常仅对本地数据的一小部分进行了标注，导致较大比例的未标注数据被闲置。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种灵活的半监督联邦多任务师生框架，利用联邦学习（FL）在参与站点之间同时使用有标注和未标注数据来改进多器官分割。在每一轮通信中，所提出的框架启动本地训练，拥有相同任务标签的客户端组成联邦以产生聚合的教师模型。由此得到的教师模型……
tldr: 提出了FedMust框架，一种半监督多任务的师生联邦学习方法，在保护隐私的前提下联合利用各机构的有标注与未标注数据，有效提升多器官CT分割性能。
en_tdlr: FedMust is a flexible semi-supervised multi-task student-teacher federated learning framework that leverages both labeled and unlabeled data across participating institutions to improve multi-organ CT segmentation while preserving data privacy.
